saw_lines: Food makers buy label software when a recipe changes or a rule shifts, then keep it only if it saves time.
So the sale is won at pricing, where a small team weighs the yearly plan against the spreadsheet they already use.
Your site offers 15% off the yearly subscription. Put that offer in the opening line of your 51 Google creatives so new buyers have a reason to act.
